574-2317-5478-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-2317-5478-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

586-678-4247.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5332-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1477-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
1477-2595-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-2595-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1477-5131-6595--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-6595--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

4050-7084-7892.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1090-2146-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1849-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-1849-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1849-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

877-3081-3817-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2279-3240-5231-6462.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

710-2438-7424.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2178-5256-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-2033-3713-5078.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

2609-7117.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Repeat.

372-3967-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-4289-5295-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

101-1170-2196-2701.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
101-1170-2196-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

2457-4289-5223-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

745-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Mirrorhall Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
745-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Mirrorhall Mimic to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

1636-3143-4642-6172.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6172.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Sunspring Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Sunspring Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2724-3582-3987-5256.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Wormfang Manta's power.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

2-1283-1379-1651-5043.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue spell.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Ancestral Statue and the Faerie, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's last ability to draw infinite cards, or you may untap any other artifact(s) you control.

647-3259-3973-4214.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith or Urabrask the Hidden.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-3973-4214.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
